feeStatusNote: Fees are chosen automatically: 'domestic' when the child's nationality matches the education country (or, for Germany, any EU/EEA country; for the UK, the UK or Ireland; for Australia, Australia or New Zealand), otherwise 'international'. Residence, settled status and scholarships can change the real fee status — confirm with the university. Ireland: EU/EEA, Swiss and UK nationals pay the EU rate (Free Fees Initiative, which also needs 3 of the last 5 years' residence in the EU, EEA, Switzerland or UK); everyone else pays non-EU fees. Qatar and the UAE: citizens study free at public universities; residents of other nationalities pay the published fees.

professionalQualificationNote: ACCA, CPA and CA are professional qualifications, not university degrees. Their cost is modelled as an exam-and-membership pathway (registration, yearly subscription, exam fees and, where usual, tuition-provider classes). Exemptions from a related degree can shorten the pathway. CPA is modelled as the US CPA in the USA and CPA Australia in Australia; CA is modelled where a national chartered-accountancy institute offers it.

exchangeRates.convention: Units of each currency per 1 USD. EUR, GBP, AUD and INR are derived as cross-rates from ECB euro reference rates (1 EUR = 1.1298 USD; 0.85373 GBP; 1.6255 AUD; 108.8320 INR). PKR from State Bank of Pakistan M2M revaluation rate. Convert A to B: amount_A / rate_A * rate_B. SGD and MYR are ECB cross-rates for the same date (1 EUR = 1.4460 SGD; 4.6147 MYR). QAR and AED are the official US-dollar pegs (QAR 3.64; AED 3.6725).
